summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests acalabrutinib plus obinutuzumab in adults with untreated follicular lymphoma or other indolent non-Hodgkin lymphomas. Acalabrutinib is taken by mouth twice a day on days 1-28 of each 28-day cycle, and obinutuzumab is given by IV on days 1, 8, and 15 of cycle 3 and on day 1 of cycles 4-8, for up to 12 cycles if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa acalabrutinib junto con obinutuzumab en adultos con linfoma folicular no tratado u otros linfomas no Hodgkin indolentes. El acalabrutinib se toma por vía oral dos veces al día durante los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y el obinutuzumab se administra por vía intravenosa los días 1, 8 y 15 del ciclo 3 y el día 1 de los ciclos 4 a 8, por hasta 12 ciclos si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es un ensayo de fase 2.
who_for: Previously untreated follicular lymphoma grade 1 to 3a, or certain other indolent B-cell lymphomas or mantle cell lymphoma, in the listed scenarios.
Measurable or assessable disease, such as a node or site of at least 1.5 cm, or bone marrow or blood involvement that can be reassessed.
Agrees to use contraception and is willing to complete all study evaluations.
not_for: Histologically transformed or co-existing high-grade or aggressive non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
Confirmed active or prior central nervous system disease.
Prior lymphoma-directed therapy or prior antibody-based therapy, with listed exceptions.
Clinically significant heart disease, or stroke or intracranial hemorrhage within 6 months.
Active bleeding, or a bleeding disorder, or uncontrolled AIHA or ITP.
